verses.zh: 设筵满屋，大家相争，不如有块干饼，大家相安。
verses.kjv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
verses.en: Better a dry crust with peace and quiet than a house full of feasting with fighting.

verses.zh: 仆人办事聪明，必管辖贻羞之子，又在众子中同分产业。
verses.kjv: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.en: A clever servant will end up in charge of a shameful son, and will share the family inheritance.

verses.zh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金；惟有耶和华熬炼人心。
verses.kjv: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
verses.en: A pot tests silver and a furnace tests gold, but the LORD tests people's hearts.

verses.zh: 行恶的，留心听奸诈之言；说谎的，侧耳听邪恶之语。
verses.kjv: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
verses.en: Someone who does wrong listens to lying lips, and a liar pays attention to a wicked tongue.

verses.zh: 戏笑穷人的，是辱没造他的主；幸灾乐祸的，必不免受罚。
verses.kjv: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
verses.en: Laughing at a poor person insults the God who made them; being glad at someone's disaster will not go unpunished.

verses.zh: 子孙为老人的冠冕；父亲是儿女的荣耀。
verses.kjv: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
verses.en: Grandchildren are the crown of the old, and parents are the pride of their children.

verses.zh: 愚顽人说美言本不相宜，何况君王说谎话呢？
verses.kjv: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.en: Fine words do not suit a fool — and lying words suit a ruler even less.

verses.zh: 贿赂在馈送的人眼中看为宝玉，随处运动都得顺利。
verses.kjv: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
verses.en: A bribe looks like a magic jewel to whoever gives it; they think it works wherever they turn.

verses.zh: 遮掩人过的，寻求人爱；屡次挑错的，离间密友。
verses.kjv: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
verses.en: Covering over a wrong keeps love alive, but bringing it up again and again splits friends apart.

verses.zh: 一句责备话深入聪明人的心，强如责打愚昧人一百下。
verses.kjv: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.en: One word of correction sinks deeper into a wise person than a hundred blows into a fool.

verses.zh: 恶人只寻背叛，所以必有严厉的使者奉差攻击他。
verses.kjv: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.en: A bad person only wants to rebel, so a harsh messenger will be sent against him.

verses.zh: 宁可遇见丢崽子的母熊，不可遇见正行愚妄的愚昧人。
verses.kjv: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.en: Better to meet a mother bear robbed of her cubs than a fool in the middle of his foolishness.

verses.zh: 以恶报善的，祸患必不离他的家。
verses.kjv: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.en: If someone pays back good with evil, trouble will never leave their house.

verses.zh: 纷争的起头如水放开，所以，在争闹之先必当止息争竞。
verses.kjv: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
verses.en: Starting a quarrel is like letting out water, so drop the matter before the fight breaks out.

verses.zh: 定恶人为义的，定义人为恶的，这都为耶和华所憎恶。
verses.kjv: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD.
verses.en: Letting a guilty person off and blaming an innocent one — the LORD hates them both.

verses.zh: 愚昧人既无聪明，为何手拿价银买智慧呢？
verses.kjv: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
verses.en: What good is money in a fool's hand to buy wisdom, when he does not really want it?

verses.zh: 朋友乃时常亲爱，弟兄为患难而生。
verses.kjv: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.en: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born to help in trouble.

verses.zh: 在邻舍面前击掌作保乃是无知的人。
verses.kjv: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
verses.en: Only a person with no sense shakes hands to take on a neighbour's debt.

verses.zh: 喜爱争竞的，是喜爱过犯；高立家门的，乃自取败坏。
verses.kjv: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
verses.en: Whoever loves quarrelling loves doing wrong, and whoever builds his gate too high is asking for ruin.

verses.zh: 心存邪僻的，寻不着好处；舌弄是非的，陷在祸患中。
verses.kjv: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
verses.en: A twisted heart finds nothing good, and a lying tongue falls into trouble.

verses.zh: 生愚昧子的，必自愁苦；愚顽人的父毫无喜乐。
verses.kjv: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
verses.en: Having a foolish child brings sorrow; the father of a fool has no joy.

verses.zh: 喜乐的心乃是良药；忧伤的灵使骨枯干。
verses.kjv: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
verses.en: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

verses.zh: 恶人暗中受贿赂，为要颠倒判断。
verses.kjv: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
verses.en: A bad person takes a bribe in secret to twist what is fair.

verses.zh: 明哲人眼前有智慧；愚昧人眼望地极。
verses.kjv: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
verses.en: A person who understands keeps wisdom in view, but a fool's eyes wander to the ends of the earth.

verses.zh: 愚昧子使父亲愁烦，使母亲忧苦。
verses.kjv: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
verses.en: A foolish son grieves his father and brings bitterness to the mother who bore him.

verses.zh: 刑罚义人为不善；责打君子为不义。
verses.kjv: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
verses.en: It is wrong to punish someone who has done no wrong, or to beat honest leaders for being fair.

verses.zh: 寡少言语的，有知识；性情温良的，有聪明。
verses.kjv: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
verses.en: Someone who knows things uses few words, and a person who understands stays calm.

verses.zh: 愚昧人若静默不言也可算为智慧；闭口不说也可算为聪明。
verses.kjv: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
verses.en: Even a fool seems wise when he keeps quiet, and sensible when he shuts his mouth.
